english.title: Owner or occupier fail to produce plans, allow copies and provide information re: sewer, drain, pipe, channel, outlet
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_ of land on or under which was situated (C)_[a sewer]_
(D)_[a drain]_
(E)_[a pipe]_
(F)_[a channel]_
(G)_[an outlet]_used or intended to be used for discharging trade effluent into a sewer of a sewerage undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKER..), failed, when requested to do so by the undertaker, to produce all such plans of the (H)_[sewer]_
(I)_[drain]_
(J)_[pipe]_
(K)_[channel]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 204(3) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the owner or occupier of land under which was situated a sewer, drain, pipe, channel or outlet
used or intended to be used for discharging trade effluent into a sewer of a sewerage undertaker,
failed, when requested to do so by the undertaker,
produce all such plans of the sewer, drain, pipe, channel or outlet as you possessed or were able, without expense, to obtain,
allow copies of the plans so produced by you to be made by, or under the directions of, the undertaker
and furnish to the undertaker all such information as you could reasonably be expected to supply
with respect to the sewer, drain, pipe, channel or outlet
